title: Groove
summary: GROOVE, noun groov. 1. A furrow, channel, or long hollow cut by a tool. Among joiners, a channel in the edge of a molding, style or rail. 2. Among miners, a shaft or pit sunk into the earth. GROOVE, v

inlines.v: GROOVE, noun groov. 1. A furrow, channel, or long hollow cut by a tool. Among joiners, a channel in the edge of a molding, style or rail. 2. Among miners, a shaft or pit sunk into the earth. GROOVE, verb transitive To cut a channel with an edged tool; to furrow.
